datos.cita_tipo: The Affiliate Partner needs to own a valid license of TIMIFY in order to be enrolled or accepted by TIMIFY into the affiliate program.

comision.cita: The Affiliate Partner receives a commission for each Service Provider referred by the Affiliate Partner who concludes a contract with TIMIFY.

recurrencia.cita: The commission for each referred Service Provider is limited to the (contract) duration during which the Service Provider uses TIMIFY.

condiciones.cita: Self-referrals for affiliate purchases are strictly prohibited.

promociona_producto_para_negocios.cita: Registered companies ("Service Providers") can advertise their services to their customers or interested parties with the help of TIMIFY

activo.cita: With approval, Affiliate Partner receives the right for the duration of the cooperation to promote TIMIFY and to call himself "TIMIFY Affiliate Partner".
